svg.title: Security code logic: DIP switches, AND-OR matrix and 4-bit shift register
svg.desc: Four DIP switch code digits feed a 4 by 4 grid of AND gates A1 to D4. Each AND gate takes one DIP switch line and one shift register output Q0 to Q3. The four gates of each row feed an OR gate, giving four BCD code outputs to the security code logic. A 4-bit shift register with serial input grounded, a 1 on the first parallel input and the others grounded, SH/LD and clock inputs generates Q0 to Q3.
